title: Implement Web Audio API Sound Synthesizer/Manager
description: Create a procedural sound effect manager using the Web Audio API to generate game audio (laser fire, asteroid explosion, player destruction) without relying on external asset files. Include unit tests mocking the audio context.
acceptanceCriteria: Audio manager initializes the AudioContext correctly upon user interaction
Sound trigger functions execute oscillator/gain nodes without throwing errors
reviewFeedback: The AudioManager implementation meets all functional and architectural requirements, utilizes efficient pre-allocated shared buffers, avoids common Web Audio API exponential ramp crashes with zero values, and is thoroughly covered by unit tests.
